How to play: Score /100: wealth 40, reserves 35, liquidity 15, knowledge 10. Start with 80 HUB. Solo: Easy is free; Medium commits 40, Hard 80. Duet/group stakes are 10/40/80; clear Hub first to qualify for a wager win. Win to reclaim it plus rewards; losing or abandoning forfeits it.
玩法说明: 满分100：资产40、储备35、流动性15、知识10。初始80 HUB。单人简单免费，中等锁定40、困难80。双人／多人锁定10／40／80；须先通关才有资格获得对局奖励。获胜返还并奖励；失败或放弃扣除锁定积分。

How to play: The dashboard appears before the stage starts and updates after each decision: capital mix, available money, locked capital, debt, reserve months and next month’s known obligations. Chart lines connect saved checkpoints, not live market prices. Forecasts exclude uncertain income and unexpected bills, so a positive balance does not guarantee safety. The original procedural soundtrack starts only when you turn it on; adjust volume or stop it anytime. It pauses when the tab is hidden.
玩法说明: 财务看板在开局前显示，并随每次决策更新资金结构、可用资金、锁定资本、债务、储备月数及下月已知义务。图表连接已保存节点，并非实时行情。预测不含不确定收入和突发账单，正余额不保证安全。原创程序音乐仅手动开启，可随时调节或关闭；切换到后台会暂停。

How to play: Easy month 1: start with $7,000 cash and $3,000 reserves. Move $500 to reserves → $6,500 cash and $3,500 reserves. Draw two Opportunity spaces and choose one. Collect $1,800 salary and pay $1,400 living costs → $6,900 cash. Buy or decline the opportunity. A solvent 12-month Easy completion at 60 points earns 12 HUB, taking an untouched starting balance from 80 to 92.
玩法说明: 简单第1个月：现金 $7,000、储备 $3,000。转入 $500 储备后为现金 $6,500、储备 $3,500。从两个机会格选一个。收到工资 $1,800、支付生活费 $1,400 后现金为 $6,900，再决定买入或放弃。简单难度完成12个月、无未付义务且60分时奖励12 HUB；若原始80未变化，余额为92。

How to play: You see each landing type before choosing, but not its specific card. Both options always share the same category; each space may reveal a different card, no route guarantees a win. Reloading preserves the locked destinations. You control your route, reserves, investment size, installment debt, optional purchases and quiz answers. Events and markets still involve chance: this version gives more agency but does not eliminate luck or provide a standardized skill ranking.
玩法说明: 选择前能看到落格类别，但看不到具体卡片。两个格子始终同类，可能揭示不同卡片；没有路线保证获胜。刷新会保留已锁定目的地。你可控制路线、储备、投资额、分期债务、可选消费和答题。事件和市场仍含随机性；本版本增加自主决策，并未消除运气或提供标准化能力排名。

How to play: Before each turn, move money between cash and reserves or buy/sell the simulated portfolio. Buying an investment does not immediately reduce net worth.
玩法说明: 每回合前可调配现金与储备，或买卖模拟投资。买入投资并不会立即减少净资产。

How to play: Each turn is a month: earn $1,800 and pay $1,400 living costs. A random die (1–6) chooses your destination. Only the landing space applies; passing a space has no effect.
玩法说明: 每回合为一个月：收入 $1,800、生活费 $1,400。随机骰子1至6决定目的地；仅落格触发事件，经过不触发。

How to play: Unexpected costs use reserves, then cash, then forced investment sales. If the cost still cannot be covered, the game ends early. There is no borrowing in this version.
玩法说明: 突发费用先用储备，再用现金，最后被迫出售投资。仍无法支付则提前结束。本版本不支持借款。

How to play: Market events apply −20%, +12% or −10% to investments held. Extra income pays $600; landing on Start pays $300. There is no fixed investment return.
玩法说明: 市场事件对已有投资应用 −20%、+12% 或 −10%。额外收入为 $600，落在起点为 $300。没有固定投资回报。

How to play: Score: wealth up to 40 ($14,800 benchmark), reserve up to 35 ($4,200 benchmark), liquidity up to 15 (minus 5 per forced sale), knowledge up to 10 (correct-answer rate). No questions encountered means 0 knowledge points.
玩法说明: 计分：资产最高40分（基准 $14,800）、储备最高35分（基准 $4,200）、流动性最高15分（每次被迫出售扣5分）、知识最高10分（按正确率）。没有遇到问题则知识得分为0。

How to play: Progress saves in this browser. VI and EN share the same game. Two-player same-device duet is available on a separate page.
玩法说明: 进度保存在此浏览器。VI、EN 和中文共用同一局游戏。另有同设备双人页面。

How to play: Goal: finish 12 months, meet all due payments and reach the level’s score target. Having the most money alone does not guarantee a win.
玩法说明: 目标：完成12个月、支付全部到期义务，并达到对应难度分数。钱最多并不保证获胜。

How to play: Practice with money before it is real. Choose your route, balance cash flow and stay solvent for 12 months.
玩法说明: 投入真金白银之前先练习。选择路线、平衡现金流，并在12个月中保持偿付能力。
第一次玩？用60秒了解规则

How to play: Read the introduction, full rules & examples →
玩法说明: 阅读介绍、完整规则与示例 →

How to play: A playful game counter, not a measure of happiness or right and wrong.
玩法说明: 趣味游戏计数，不代表幸福程度或对错评判。

How to play: An answer matters when you can explain its cash-flow and risk consequences. Multiplayer answers are not disclosed ahead of opponents’ turns.
玩法说明: 能够解释现金流和风险后果，答案才有意义。多人答案不会在对手回合前提前公开。

How to play: Before buying, subtract living costs, installments and reserves from liquid funds. For illiquid assets, stress-test an income drop as well as expected returns.
玩法说明: 买入前，先从流动资金扣除生活费、分期及所需储备。对难以变现的资产，除预期收益外，还要压力测试收入下降。

How to play: Cash avoids short-term volatility but gives up some growth. Diversification reduces concentration risk, not market-wide risk.
玩法说明: 现金避开短期波动，也放弃部分增长机会。分散投资减少集中风险，不能消除系统性市场风险。

How to play: Consider: has your thesis changed, do you need cash soon, and are weights above your limits? One down month does not automatically justify selling; holding forever is not automatically right either.
玩法说明: 考虑投资逻辑是否改变、近期是否需用现金、仓位是否超限。一个月下跌不自动意味着该卖，永远持有也不一定正确。

How to play: Higher net worth must be read alongside money available to pay obligations.
玩法说明: 较高净资产也须结合可用于偿付义务的资金来看。

How to play: Keeping cash preserves next month’s choices. Passing is not a failure when investing would leave required bills unfunded.
玩法说明: 保留现金让下个月仍有选择。若投资会影响支付必要账单，放弃并不代表失败。

How to play: Knowing a concept does not guarantee using it under pressure. Separate facts, assumptions and unknowns before deciding.
玩法说明: 懂概念不代表能在压力下运用。决策前请分清事实、假设与未知。

How to play: Locked assets cannot be used to pay an urgent bill.
玩法说明: 锁定资产无法用于即时支付紧急账单。

How to play: Low reserves can force a sale at an unfavorable time; positive net worth can coexist with an inability to pay.
玩法说明: 储备不足可能迫使你在不利时点卖出；净资产为正也可能无力付款。

How to play: Opportunity cost includes foregone returns and fewer months of financial safety. Consumption is not inherently bad; unaffordable consumption makes the plan fragile.
玩法说明: 机会成本包括放弃的收益及减少的财务安全月数。消费本身并非坏事，超出能力的消费才会使计划脆弱。

How to play: Prioritize due obligations, rebuild reserves, then split the remainder between investing and enjoyment using a pre-set allocation.
玩法说明: 先支付到期义务、补足储备，再按预设比例分配投资与享受。

How to play: Read cash flow and obligations first, then decide within the limit. If information is insufficient, deliberately pass on the investment rather than leaving the whole turn unattended.
玩法说明: 先读现金流与义务，再在时限内决定。信息不足时主动放弃投资，不要整回合放置不管。

How to play: Rebuild reserves before increasing risk. Estimate essential monthly costs, review suitable insurance and budget separately for predictable maintenance.
玩法说明: 增加风险前先补足储备。估计每月必要费用、审视合适保险，并为可预见维修单独留预算。

How to play: Restate the principle in your own words, identify a case where it is insufficient and set one concrete limit for your next money decision.
玩法说明: 用自己的话重述原则，找出它不充分的情境，并为下一次财务决策设定一个具体限制。

How to play: Review weights, time horizon and loss capacity. Rebalance to a plan; do not increase exposure merely after a win or panic-sell merely after a fall.
玩法说明: 审视权重、期限和亏损承受力。依计划再平衡，不因一次获利加仓，也不因一次下跌恐慌卖出。

How to play: Separate needs from wants. Wait 48 hours, calculate total ownership costs and buy only if obligations and reserves remain protected.
玩法说明: 区分需要与想要。等待48小时，计算总持有成本，确保义务和储备不受影响后再买。

How to play: Separate one-off money: cover obligations, rebuild reserves, then allocate to long-term goals and enjoyment. Do not infer that paying to chase luck is worthwhile.
玩法说明: 单独规划一次性收入：先付义务、补储备，再分配长期目标与享受。这不代表花钱追逐运气值得。

How to play: Spending everything brings enjoyment today; holding everything also has opportunity cost. Goal-based allocation helps prevent immediate lifestyle inflation.
玩法说明: 花光带来当下享受，全留也有机会成本。按目标分配有助于避免生活开支立即膨胀。

How to play: Treating irregular receipts as a new salary can raise fixed spending and create a shortfall next month. Luck is not a repeatable strategy.
玩法说明: 把偶发收入当成固定工资，可能增加固定开支并导致下月缺口。运气不是可复制策略。

How to play: Waiting can avoid a rushed choice, but it cannot pause bills, installments or changes in assets you already own.
玩法说明: 等待可以避免仓促决定，但无法暂停账单、分期和已有资产变化。

How to play: You may pass. Uses cash only, with no automatic reserve draw or borrowing. Experiences have value too; enjoyment is tracked separately from the financial score.
玩法说明: 可以放弃。仅使用现金，不自动动用储备或借款。体验也有价值；体验分与财务分分别记录。

How to play: You postponed a want to preserve money for other priorities. A discount does not turn an unnecessary purchase into savings.
玩法说明: 你推迟了想要的消费，为其他优先事项保留资金。折扣不会把不必要购买变成储蓄。

How to play: HUB is currently a simulated token in Money Lab Hub for game rewards and commitments. It has no real-money value, is not issued on-chain and cannot be bought, sold or redeemed for OKB.
玩法说明: 此处 HUB 是 Money Lab Hub 的模拟积分，用于奖励和锁定。没有现实货币价值、未在此模拟账本上链，不能买卖或兑换 OKB。

How to play: Future direction: develop HUB into a tradable utility token within Money Lab Hub, used to access paid game modes and ecosystem services. Those modes may require purchasing HUB before entry. This is a research roadmap: no sale, market or price exists, and value, liquidity or returns are not guaranteed. Real-token economics and competition rewards require separate design and evaluation before launch.
玩法说明: 未来研究方向：探索可交易的 HUB 实用代币，用于付费模式及生态服务，可能涉及购买后进入。目前仅为研究路线，没有发售、市场或价格，不保证价值、流动性或回报。真实代币经济与赛事奖励须在上线前另行设计评估。

How to play: What is HUB? Today & future direction
玩法说明: HUB 是什么？现状与未来方向

How to play: Monopoly is a property trading board game originating in the United States. Money Lab Hub draws inspiration from moving around a board and making financial decisions, with its own rules for practicing money management before using real money. This independent project is not an official Monopoly edition or endorsed by Hasbro.
玩法说明: Monopoly 是起源于美国的地产交易桌游。Money Lab Hub 借鉴沿棋盘移动及财务决策的形式，采用独立规则练习资金管理。本项目并非官方 Monopoly 版本，也未获孩之宝认可。

How to play: Enter the next stage directly without resetting your profile or returning to a menu.
玩法说明: 直接进入下一关，无需重置档案或返回菜单。

How to play: Asset categories respond differently to this fictional scenario. Equities and crypto may fall together; more tickers do not guarantee diversification. Cash and reserves stay unchanged.
玩法说明: 各类资产对此虚构情境反应不同。股票与加密资产可能同跌；代码更多不保证分散风险。现金和储备不变。

How to play: Money Lab supplies financial inputs; TapeOut does not attest the money source or the whole game.
玩法说明: Money Lab 提供财务输入；TapeOut 不验证资金来源或整局游戏。

How to play: Amounts and checks above are game calculations, not chain-read evidence yet. The 1-month / 30% thresholds are educational; passing does not guarantee profit. The existing STOP gate still blocks new investment.
玩法说明: 以上金额和检查由游戏计算，尚非链上读取证据。1个月／30%阈值用于教学，通过不保证盈利。现有停止关卡仍可阻止新增投资。

How to play: The 1-month / 30% thresholds are illustrative Money Lab rules, not safety standards. The game calculates financial inputs. Use the explicit check to read deployed REF #49 when configured; the report identifies any local truth-table composition. It changes no score, HUB or settlement.
玩法说明: 1个月／30%是 Money Lab 的教学示例规则，不是安全标准。财务输入由游戏计算。配置就绪时，点击检查会读取已部署 REF #49；若使用本地真值表组合，报告会明确标注。此检查不改变得分、HUB 或结算。

How to play: Forecast rules are not applied after stage end. Select an earlier decision.
玩法说明: 关卡结束后不再推演下一月，请选择较早的决策。

How to play: This choice ends the stage: no month-13 forecast.
玩法说明: 此选择结束本关，不生成第13个月预测。

How to play: This is the original stop-gate receipt, not proof of the complete game or alternative branch.
玩法说明: 这是原始停止关卡记录，不是整局游戏或替代分支的证明。

How to play: Offchain composition using actual TapeOut truth-table reads; the REF design is not activated. Money Lab supplies financial inputs.

How to play: Sign in with a wallet for shared Solo/Online HUB across devices. Browser-only guest Solo HUB does not migrate into the server profile.

How to play: Sign in with a wallet to share Solo HUB and recover your seat across devices. Guest seats stay in this browser; HUB is entirely fictional.
玩法说明: 使用钱包登录，可共享单人 HUB 并跨设备恢复席位。游客席位仅在此浏览器保留；HUB 完全为虚构积分。

玩法说明: 房间已变化，正在刷新，请重新操作。

How to play: Only Hub clears qualify to win the wager. Hub rewards remain independent.
玩法说明: 只有通关者有资格获得对局奖励；通关 HUB 奖励独立结算。

How to play: Everyone gets the same event category and two spaces this month. Choose one; its scenario is revealed afterward.
玩法说明: 本月所有人获得相同事件类别和两个格子。选一个后才揭示具体情境。

How to play: debt remains payable even if the asset loses value.

How to play: Move $1,500 of cash into a simulated portfolio. Market spaces change its value. Returns are never guaranteed.
玩法说明: 将 $1,500 现金转入模拟投资组合。市场格会改变其价值，收益从不保证。

玩法说明: 共享区域格。事件遵守回合时限并记录。选择地块可查看规划与三个投资阶段。

How to play: Actual game revenue varies with seasons and demand. Cash flow starts on the owner’s next monthly turn after opening.
玩法说明: 游戏收入随季节与需求变化。营业后，从业主下一月回合开始产生现金流。

How to play: Asset values use contributed land/construction cost, not market prices. This initial version has no land sales, new loans, auctions, transfers, World 2/3 wagers or HUB rewards. These can be developed later.
玩法说明: 资产按土地／建设投入成本计值，并非市场价。初版没有土地出售、新借款、拍卖、转让、World 2／3 对局积分或 HUB 奖励；未来可继续开发。

How to play: Board amounts are simulated USD, separate from HUB. Compare the money that remains available before choosing.

How to play: Build HUB in World 1. You can still explore the map and project walkthrough below.
玩法说明: 先在 World 1 积累 HUB。仍可浏览下方地图和项目演示。

How to play: Follow numbered spaces; the route loops back to the gateway. Ownership and 1/3–3/3 markers show project progress.
玩法说明: 沿编号格移动，路线绕回入口。所有权及1/3至3/3标记显示项目进度。

How to play: HUB is an in-game point. Public mainnet grants 80 free HUB once per wallet; it cannot be traded, transferred or withdrawn for money. Guest simulation, testnet, founder mainnet and public mainnet have separate balances and progress. Mainnet transactions cost real OKB gas.
玩法说明: HUB 是游戏积分。公开主网每钱包免费发放一次80 HUB，不可交易、转移或提现。游客模拟、测试网、创始人主网和公开主网的余额及进度独立。主网交易需真实 OKB gas。

How to play: TapeOut supplies checkable circuit logic. Circuit #48 supports the investment STOP gate; REF circuit #49 combines R/C/D checks for reserves, obligations and installments. Money Lab calculates inputs from simulated finances. Circuits do not authenticate real-world assets. HUB settlement still checks server-signed outcomes; the full game is not circuit-verified.
玩法说明: TapeOut 提供可核对的电路逻辑。#48 支持投资停止关卡；REF #49 组合储备、义务和分期的 R/C/D 条件。Money Lab 根据模拟财务计算输入。电路不认证现实资产。HUB 结算仍验证服务器签名结果，而非整局游戏均由电路证明。

How to play: Replay changes a recorded choice and compares consequences using the same recorded event seeds. It does not change the original stage or grant extra HUB. Shared seeds support comparison, but do not by themselves prove fair randomness.
玩法说明: 回放改变一个已记录选择，使用相同事件种子比较后果。不改变原始关卡，也不额外奖励 HUB。共用种子有助比较，但自身不证明随机公平。

How to play: Net worth includes cash, reserves and investments minus debt. Portfolio value is not necessarily spendable cash: locked investments may be unsellable. Before investing, review next-month cash flow, installments and remaining liquidity. Paper gains cannot pay bills.
玩法说明: 净资产为现金、储备及投资减债务。组合价值不一定是可花现金：锁定投资可能无法出售。投资前先看下月现金流、分期及剩余流动性。账面收益不能直接支付账单。

How to play: Possible reasons include insufficient cash, a blocking STOP gate, or connection/verification not being ready. Read the message beside the choice and inspect the TapeOut panel. This version of Coach cannot read your session, so it cannot determine your specific cause.
玩法说明: 可能是现金不足、触发停止关卡，或连接／验证尚未就绪。请读选择旁提示并查看 TapeOut 面板。本版助手不能读取你的游戏状态，无法确定具体原因。

How to play: Worlds 2 and 3 are early playable tourism-investment prototypes. World 2 has 25 spaces, 3–6 players and requires over 1,000 server HUB per player. World 3 has 36 spaces, 4–6 players and requires at least 10,000. Projects progress through land, construction and completion. Entry currently does not spend HUB; real-token purchases and HUB rewards for these worlds are not implemented.
玩法说明: World 2 和3是早期可玩的旅游投资原型。World 2 有25格、3至6人，每人需超过1,000服务器 HUB；World 3 有36格、4至6人，至少10,000 HUB。项目分购地、建设和竣工阶段。当前入场不消耗 HUB；真实代币购买及这些世界的 HUB 奖励尚未实现。

How to play: Open Duet / Group online to create or join a cross-device room. The room can advance only when every member qualifies; otherwise keep the current level. Public Mainnet currently supports World 1 Solo, not mainnet multiplayer.
玩法说明: 打开线上双人／多人以创建或加入跨设备房间。全员满足条件才能升级，否则保持当前难度。公开主网目前仅支持 World 1 单人，不支持主网多人。

How to play: A completed server log does not prove onchain settlement. Use the stage settlement-check button and verify a successful transaction receipt on the correct network and contract. Coach does not perform live transaction checks and cannot confirm settlement from a chat message alone.
玩法说明: 服务器完赛日志不证明链上结算。请使用关卡结算核对按钮，在正确网络和合约上检查成功交易回执。助手不实时检查交易，不能仅凭聊天确认结算。

How to play: Use the history and privacy controls to manage server records where supported. Public blockchain addresses and records cannot be erased by deleting server logs. Never send seed phrases, private keys or passwords to Coach. This chat stays in tab memory and disappears on reload.
玩法说明: 可使用历史与隐私控件管理支持删除的服务器记录。删除服务器日志不会删除公开链上地址或记录。切勿向助手发送助记词、私钥或密码。聊天仅在标签页内存中，刷新即消失。

How to play: Use Public Mainnet, sign in and connect a wallet on X Layer mainnet (196). HUB is free, but transactions use real OKB for gas. Testnet is separate: do not send real OKB there just to experiment. Review network, value and fees in your wallet before confirming yourself. Coach never signs or sends transactions.
玩法说明: 打开公开主网，登录并连接 X Layer 主网（196）钱包。HUB 免费，但交易使用真实 OKB gas。测试网独立，请勿为试验而向其发送真实 OKB。自行确认前先检查网络、金额和费用。助手从不签名或发送交易。
